title: Missing Environment
description: ./run.sh fails with: APP_ENV is not configured.
mission: Create the .env file expected by the application and configure APP_ENV for production.
success: The required environment configuration is present.

lesson.what_happened: The application depended on configuration that was absent from its environment file.
lesson.be_careful: Do not commit real secrets in .env files.

hints: The application expects a file named .env.
Copy the example, then set APP_ENV=production.
